info.name: Create or update orders by external identifier (v2)

items.docs: Create new orders or update existing ones by external identifier. Returns a `results` array — one entry per input order, in the same order as the request — each carrying a `success` or `failed` status, plus a `summary` of the counts. A hard failure on one order does not fail the batch; the rest still commit.
